architecture_posture.graph: Keep the existing deterministic, replayable ProofLaunch Graph as the deadline path; evaluate LangGraph or Temporal only behind an adapter and replay-equivalence gates.
architecture_posture.loop: Allow bounded evaluator-optimizer loops only inside research, strategy and creative nodes; every loop has an iteration, cost, latency and evidence cap.
architecture_posture.harness: All tools, models, memory writes, publication and spend pass typed schemas, tenant scope, rights checks, idempotency, budgets, audit logs and human approval.
architecture_posture.model_policy: Models are replaceable routes discovered from the AMD official model endpoint or immutable local manifests; model popularity never overrides evidence, rights or Radeon execution gates.
architecture_posture.migration_policy: No framework migration is allowed before the deadline unless it beats the current runtime on replay correctness, failure recovery, latency, cost and the frozen product regression suite.

negative_evidence.reason: Upstream repository states it is no longer maintained; use Qwen3-TTS and evaluate Step-Audio-EditX instead.
No authoritative public model repository or currently observed AMD model identifier was captured; do not claim availability.
Community license includes revenue and competitive-use conditions; legal clearance is mandatory.
No replay-equivalence and product-regression advantage has been proven over the current runtime.
Human approval, platform authorization, rights and experiment registration remain mandatory.

negative_evidence.item: GUI agents as a production authentication bypass
negative_evidence.reason: Computer-use projects are admitted only in isolated authorized environments; they may not bypass login, captcha, paywall, rate limit or platform access controls.

negative_evidence.item: Lance as a deadline production replacement
negative_evidence.reason: Upstream describes a research checkpoint with limited resolution and variable quality; it remains a specialist-ablation challenger.

truth_boundary: This second-pass radar proves that 111 official repositories were located and exact source HEAD revisions were captured on 2026-08-01, then mapped across 60 product outcomes, algorithms, model/evaluator routes and admission gates. It does not prove that an uninstalled project works in this repository, that code and model/data licenses are identical, that Radeon execution occurred, that generated assets reach 4A quality, or that business lift exists. Repository popularity and claimed benchmark rank never replace local reproducibility, blinded human judgment or observed unit economics.
